subject: general
question: Darshan starts walking 10 km towards the east. He turns right walks 6 km, then takes a right. He walks 5 m and again turns right. He turns left after walking 4 km. Then he walks 2 km, again turns left and walks another 5 km. Finally, he takes a right turn and walks 2 km. In which direction is he facing now? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given:

Darshan starts walking 10 km towards the east.

He turns right walks 6 km, then takes a right.

He walks 5 m and again turns right.

He turns left after walking 4 km.

Then he walks 2 km, again turns left and walks another 5 km.

Finally, he takes a right turn and walks 2 km. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d11b667ef6cf90b137bdda21b38e881cf4da14a3e2369ab6a37ad2db925d4d0b.png] 

Thus, Darshan is facing is the west direction now.

Hence, **"Option 3" **is the correct answer.
